findings.claim: The diff adds CANCELLED -> RUNNING to the allowed-transition table, letting a cancelled task be transitioned to RUNNING via transition(), which violates the stated lifecycle invariant that CANCELLED must never transition to RUNNING.
findings.failure_scenario: task.state = TaskState.CANCELLED; transition(task, TaskState.RUNNING) now succeeds (previously raised ValueError) and sets task.state = TaskState.RUNNING, re-activating a cancelled task in violation of INV-1.
